•Gujarat State ranked 1st in implementation of Housing for All. •Residential Affordable Housing Zone has been created in Ahmedabad. •Differential planning norms - FSI, Parking, Lower Charges for paid FSI etc. •Zoning Regulations including relaxing height restriction are also offered to boost this sector. •Gujarat has adopted a Common General Development Control Rules and applied them to all urban areas in October 2017. •Creation of RAH zone in Ahmedabad helps in boost the CLSS Creation of RAH zone to boost the housing Sector
